```{r calculate absolute error(abs) for learning phase overall and across 3 blocks: Video Study, echo=FALSE}

#This code calculates the absolute learning error for each trial of each block for each participant
#Code then identifies if any subject is an outlier on absolute error for learning trials by age group, first for each block (1,2,3) and then Overall (1,2,3 blocks averaged together)

newlist_of_files <- list.files(
    path = file.path(Clean_Data_Dir, "Learning_Recall"),#inside the cleaned non-data folder contains the learning and recall data folder with the cleaned data
    pattern = "\\.csv$",
    full.names = TRUE
)


# Create an empty dataframe to store results
results_learning_overall <- data.frame(sub_id = character(),
                         block = integer(),
                         absavg = numeric(),
                         minavg = numeric(),
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Loop through each file
for (file in newlist_of_files) {
    # Read the data from the CSV file
    data <- read.csv(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    
    # Initialize empty vectors to store errors
    err1 <- numeric(nrow(data))
    err2 <- numeric(nrow(data))
    err <- numeric(nrow(data))
    
    # Loop through rows of data
    for (i in 1:nrow(data)) {
        err1[i] <- abs(max(data[i, "locresp1_adj"], data[i, "testObj1LocTargetVal"]) - min(data[i, "locresp1_adj"], data[i, "testObj1LocTargetVal"]))
        err2[i] <- abs(360 - max(data[i, "locresp1_adj"], data[i, "testObj1LocTargetVal"]) + min(data[i, "locresp1_adj"], data[i, "testObj1LocTargetVal"]))
        
        if (err1[i] > err2[i]) { 
            err[i] <- 2
            data[i, "abs_err"] <- err2[i] 
            data[i, "prec_err"] <- 180 - err2[i] 
        } else {
            err[i] <- 1 
            data[i, "abs_err"] <- err1[i]  
            data[i, "prec_err"] <- 180 - err1[i]
        }

        # Calculate min error (+/-)
        if (err[i] == 1) { 
            data[i, "min_err"] <- (data[i, "locresp1_adj"] - data[i, "testObj1LocTargetVal"])
        } else {
            if (data[i, "locresp1_adj"] < 180) { 
                data[i, "min_err"] <- 360 - (data[i, "testObj1LocTargetVal"]) + (data[i, "locresp1_adj"])
            } else {
                data[i, "min_err"] <- -(360 - (data[i, "locresp1_adj"]) + (data[i, "testObj1LocTargetVal"]))
            }
        }
    }
    
    # Extract participant ID from filename
    sub_id <- gsub("_Learning.*", "", basename(file))

    # Compute overall averages
    absavg_total <- mean(data$abs_err, na.rm = TRUE)
    minavg_total <- mean(data$min_err, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Append overall results
results_learning_overall <- rbind(results_learning_overall, data.frame(sub_id = sub_id, block = "Overall", absavg = absavg_total, minavg = minavg_total))

    # Compute block-wise averages
    block_averages <- aggregate(cbind(abs_err, min_err) ~ block, data = data, FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE)

    # Append block results
    for (j in 1:nrow(block_averages)) {
   results_learning_overall <- rbind(results_learning_overall, data.frame(sub_id = sub_id, 
                                                   block = block_averages$block[j], 
                                                   absavg = block_averages$abs_err[j], 
                                                   minavg = block_averages$min_err[j]))
    }
}

# View results
print(results_learning_overall)

# Function to flag outliers (values > 3 SD from the mean)
flag_outliers <- function(data) {
    mean_val <- mean(data$absavg, na.rm = TRUE)
    sd_val <- sd(data$absavg, na.rm = TRUE)
    data$outlier_Learning_Age <- ifelse((data$absavg> mean_val + 3 * sd_val) | 
                           (data$absavg < mean_val - 3 * sd_val), TRUE, FALSE)
    return(data)
}


AgeGroup_ToD_Cond <- read.csv(ageGroup_file)

AgeGroup_ToD_Cond<-AgeGroup_ToD_Cond%>%
  rename(
  sub_id=participant
)
    

results_learning_overall<-merge(AgeGroup_ToD_Cond, results_learning_overall,by="sub_id")

# Identify outliers **for each block within YA and OA**
block_outliers_learning <- results_learning_overall %>%
  #filter(sub_id != "Sub002_ToD") %>%
    filter(block != "Overall") %>%
    group_by(AgeGroup, block) %>%
    group_modify(~ flag_outliers(.))

# Identify outliers **for overall absavg within YA and OA**
overall_outliers_learning <- results_learning_overall %>%
  #filter(sub_id != "Sub002_ToD") %>%
    filter(block == "Overall") %>%
    group_by(AgeGroup) %>%
    group_modify(~ flag_outliers(.))

# Combine block and overall outliers
final_outliers_df_learning <- bind_rows(block_outliers_learning, overall_outliers_learning)


# Filter only outliers
outliers_only_learning <- final_outliers_df_learning %>% filter(outlier_Learning_Age == TRUE) %>% select(-outlier_Learning_Age)

# View dataframe with only outliers
print(outliers_only_learning)


results_learning_overall <- results_learning_overall %>%
    left_join(final_outliers_df_learning %>% select(sub_id, block, outlier_Learning_Age), 
              by = c("sub_id", "block")) %>%
    select(-AgeGroup.y) %>% # Remove duplicate AgeGroup column
    rename(AgeGroup = AgeGroup.x) # Rename to keep consistency



 results_learning_overall<- results_learning_overall%>%
   #filter(sub_id!="Sub002_ToD")%>%
  rename(absavg_learning=absavg,
         minavg_learning=minavg)

  
#save results file
write.csv(results_learning_overall,
          file = file.path(AbsErr_Data_Dir, "AbsAvgChangeOverBlockLearning.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)


# Filter data for Overall block
overall_data_learning <- results_learning_overall %>%
  filter(block == "Overall")

#group_averages_overall <- aggregate(absavg ~ AgeGroup, data = overall_data, FUN = mean)


# Create bar chart
ggplot( overall_data_learning , aes(x = ToD_Condition, y = absavg_learning)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "skyblue", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Overall Mean Absolute error by ToD",
       x = "ToD Group",
       y = "Mean Absolute Error") +
  theme_minimal()
         

# Calculate group averages by both ToD_Condition and Age_Category
group_averages_overall_Age_ToD_learning <- aggregate(absavg_learning ~ ToD_Condition + AgeGroup, data = overall_data_learning , FUN = mean)

# Create a custom color palette
my_colors <- c("#FF5733", "#3498DB", "#F1C40F", "#2ECC71")

# Create bar chart with customizations
ggplot(group_averages_overall_Age_ToD_learning, aes(x = ToD_Condition, y = absavg_learning, fill = AgeGroup)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", color = "black", width = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "Learning: Group Averages by ToD Condition and Age Category",
       x = "ToD Group",
       y = "Mean Absolute Error",
       fill = "Age Group") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)) +  # Rotate x-axis labels
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors) +  # Use custom color palette
  geom_text(aes(label = paste("Mean:", round(absavg_learning, 2)), y = absavg_learning + 0.05), position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +  # Add mean values as text labels above the bars
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))  # Center the title
# Perform two-way ANOVA
anova_results_learning <- aov(absavg_learning ~ ToD_Condition * AgeGroup, data = overall_data_learning)

# Print ANOVA table
summary(anova_results_learning)


library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Filter data for Block 1, Block 2, and Block 3
block_data_learning <- results_learning_overall%>%
  filter(block %in% c("1", "2", "3"))

# Calculate group averages by ToD_Condition, AgeGroup, and block
group_averages_block_Age_ToD_learning <- aggregate(absavg_learning ~ ToD_Condition + AgeGroup + block, data = block_data_learning, FUN = mean)

# Create a custom color palette for AgeGroup and ToD_Condition
my_colors <- c("YA" = "#FF5733", "OA" = "#3498DB")

# Create bar chart with customizations, separate bars for each block
ggplot(group_averages_block_Age_ToD_learning, aes(x = block, y = absavg_learning, fill = interaction(ToD_Condition, AgeGroup))) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", color = "black", width = 0.7) + 
  labs(title = "Learning: Mean Absolute Error by Block, ToD Condition, and Age Group", 
       x = "Block", 
       y = "Mean Absolute Error", 
       fill = "ToD Condition & Age Group") + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)) +  # Rotate x-axis labels
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Morning.YA" = "#FF5733", "Night.YA" = "#F1C40F", 
                               "Morning.OA" = "#3498DB", "Night.OA" = "#2ECC71")) +  # Custom colors
  geom_text(aes(label = round(absavg_learning, 2), y = absavg_learning + 0.05), 
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +  # Add mean values as text labels above the bars
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))  # Center the title



```

```{r calcualte absolute error for Recall phase overall and across 3 blocks , echo=FALSE}

#This next code calculates the absolute error for each trial for each participant for each recall block and creates an average absolute error for each block.
#code then identifies any outliers grouping by age group for each block and then overall (averaging across the three blocks)

Recall_files <- list.files(
    path = file.path(Clean_Data_Dir, "Learning_Recall"),
    pattern = "\\.csv$",
    full.names = TRUE
)



# Create an empty dataframe to store results
results_recall_overall <- data.frame(sub_id = character(),
                         block = integer(),
                         absavg = numeric(),
                         minavg = numeric(),
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Loop through each file
for (file in Recall_files)  {
    # Read the data from the CSV file
    data <- read.csv(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    
    # Initialize empty vectors to store errors
    err1 <- numeric(nrow(data))
    err2 <- numeric(nrow(data))
    err <- numeric(nrow(data))
    
    # Loop through rows of data
    for (i in 1:nrow(data)) {
        err1[i] <- abs(max(data[i, "locresp2_adj"], data[i, "testObj1LocTargetVal"]) - min(data[i, "locresp2_adj"], data[i, "testObj1LocTargetVal"]))
        err2[i] <- abs(360 - max(data[i, "locresp2_adj"], data[i, "testObj1LocTargetVal"]) + min(data[i, "locresp2_adj"], data[i, "testObj1LocTargetVal"]))
        
        if (err1[i] > err2[i]) { 
            err[i] <- 2
            data[i, "abs_err"] <- err2[i] 
            data[i, "prec_err"] <- 180 - err2[i] 
        } else {
            err[i] <- 1 
            data[i, "abs_err"] <- err1[i]  
            data[i, "prec_err"] <- 180 - err1[i]
        }

        # Calculate min error (+/-)
        if (err[i] == 1) { 
            data[i, "min_err"] <- (data[i, "locresp2_adj"] - data[i, "testObj1LocTargetVal"])
        } else {
            if (data[i, "locresp2_adj"] < 181) { 
                data[i, "min_err"] <- 360 - (data[i, "testObj1LocTargetVal"]) + (data[i, "locresp2_adj"])
            } else {
                data[i, "min_err"] <- -(360 - (data[i, "locresp2_adj"]) + (data[i, "testObj1LocTargetVal"]))
            }
        }
    }
    
    # Extract participant ID from filename
    sub_id <- gsub("_Learning.*", "", basename(file))

    # Compute overall averages
    absavg_total <- mean(data$abs_err, na.rm = TRUE)
    minavg_total <- mean(data$min_err, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Append overall results
results_recall_overall  <- rbind(results_recall_overall , data.frame(sub_id = sub_id, block = "Overall", absavg = absavg_total, minavg = minavg_total))

    # Compute block-wise averages
    block_averages <- aggregate(cbind(abs_err, min_err) ~ block, data = data, FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE)

    # Append block results
    for (j in 1:nrow(block_averages)) {
   results_recall_overall  <- rbind(results_recall_overall , data.frame(sub_id = sub_id, 
                                                   block = block_averages$block[j], 
                                                   absavg = block_averages$abs_err[j], 
                                                   minavg = block_averages$min_err[j]))
    }
}

# View results
print(results_recall_overall)

    
AgeGroup_ToD_Cond <- read.csv(ageGroup_file)


AgeGroup_ToD_Cond<-AgeGroup_ToD_Cond%>%
  rename(
  sub_id=participant
)
    

results_recall_overall <-merge(AgeGroup_ToD_Cond, results_recall_overall,by="sub_id")

flag_outliers <- function(data) {
    mean_val <- mean(data$absavg, na.rm = TRUE)
    sd_val <- sd(data$absavg, na.rm = TRUE)
    data$outlier_Recall_Age <- ifelse((data$absavg > mean_val + 3 * sd_val) |

}

 #Add outlier column to the main dataframe

ggplot(group_averages_overall_Age_ToD_Recall, aes(x = ToD_Condition, y = absavg_recall, fill = AgeGroup)) +
```

```{r Identify outliers for ToD data by block and overall for each age group, echo=FALSE}


#Summary data from Script that calculated number of items correctly identified as old etc.

library(dplyr)

# Read Recall Summary Data
Summary_Recall_Data <- read.csv(file.path(Clean_Data_Dir, "Summary_Data_Video.csv"))


# score for each block by age group: detect outliers for all, but most interested in correct recall old
# Compute block-level z-scores
Summary_Data_All_zScore <- Summary_Recall_Data %>%
  group_by(block, AgeGroup) %>%
  mutate(
    z_CorrectRecallOld = scale(CorrectRecallOld)[,1],
    z_ForgetRecallOld  = scale(ForgetRecallOld)[,1],
    z_CorrectRecallNew = scale(CorrectRecallNew)[,1],
    z_NewRecallOld     = scale(NewRecallOld)[,1],

    Outlier_Block_CorrectRecallOld = abs(z_CorrectRecallOld) > 3,
    Outlier_Block_ForgetRecallOld  = abs(z_ForgetRecallOld)  > 3,
    Outlier_Block_CorrectRecallNew = abs(z_CorrectRecallNew) > 3,
    Outlier_Block_NewRecallOld     = abs(z_NewRecallOld)     > 3,

    Outlier_Block_Any =
      Outlier_Block_CorrectRecallOld |
      Outlier_Block_ForgetRecallOld  |
      Outlier_Block_CorrectRecallNew |
      Outlier_Block_NewRecallOld
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Merge ALL z-score columns + outlier flags back into main dataset
Summary_Recall_Data <- Summary_Recall_Data %>%
  left_join(
    Summary_Data_All_zScore %>%
      select(
        participant, block, AgeGroup,
        z_CorrectRecallOld, z_ForgetRecallOld,
        z_CorrectRecallNew, z_NewRecallOld,
        Outlier_Block_CorrectRecallOld,
        Outlier_Block_ForgetRecallOld,
        Outlier_Block_CorrectRecallNew,
        Outlier_Block_NewRecallOld,
        Outlier_Block_Any
      ),
    by = c("participant", "block", "AgeGroup")
  )

# Compute overall z-scores
Z_Data_Group_Overall <- Summary_Recall_Data %>%
  filter(block == "Overall") %>%
  group_by(AgeGroup) %>%
  mutate(
    z_CorrectRecallOld_Overall = scale(CorrectRecallOld)[,1],
    z_ForgetRecallOld_Overall  = scale(ForgetRecallOld)[,1],
    z_CorrectRecallNew_Overall = scale(CorrectRecallNew)[,1],
    z_NewRecallOld_Overall     = scale(NewRecallOld)[,1],

    Outlier_Overall_CorrectRecallOld = abs(z_CorrectRecallOld_Overall) > 3,
    Outlier_Overall_ForgetRecallOld  = abs(z_ForgetRecallOld_Overall)  > 3,
    Outlier_Overall_CorrectRecallNew = abs(z_CorrectRecallNew_Overall) > 3,
    Outlier_Overall_NewRecallOld     = abs(z_NewRecallOld_Overall)     > 3,

    Outlier_Overall_Any =
      Outlier_Overall_CorrectRecallOld |
      Outlier_Overall_ForgetRecallOld  |
      Outlier_Overall_CorrectRecallNew |
      Outlier_Overall_NewRecallOld
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


potential_outliers_overall <- Z_Data_Group_Overall %>%
  filter(Outlier_Overall_Any)

potential_outliers_CorrectRecallOld <- Z_Data_Group_Overall %>%
  filter(Outlier_Block_CorrectRecallOld)

library(dplyr)
summary_group_stats <- Summary_Data_NoOutliers %>%
  filter(block=="Overall")%>%

  summarise(
    mean_CorrectRecallOld = round(mean(CorrectRecallOld)),
    se_CorrectRecallOld = round(sd(CorrectRecallOld) / sqrt(n())),
    mean_ForgetRecallOld = round(mean(ForgetRecallOld)),
    se_ForgetRecallOld = round(sd(ForgetRecallOld) / sqrt(n())),
    mean_CorrectRecallNew = round(mean(CorrectRecallNew)),
    se_CorrectRecallNew = round(sd(CorrectRecallNew) / sqrt(n())),
    mean_NewRecallOld = round(mean(NewRecallOld)),
    se_NewRecallOld = round(sd(NewRecallOld) / sqrt(n()))
  )


# Reshape the summarized data to long format
summary_means <- summary_group_stats %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("mean_"), names_to = "ResponseType", values_to = "Mean") %>%
  mutate(ResponseType = str_replace(ResponseType, "mean_", ""))

summary_se <- summary_group_stats %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("se_"), names_to = "ResponseType", values_to = "SE") %>%
  mutate(ResponseType = str_replace(ResponseType, "se_", ""))

# Combine means and SEs
summary_long <- inner_join(summary_means, summary_se, by = c("ToD_Condition", "AgeGroup", "ResponseType"))

# Reshape the original summary data for individual points

  pivot_longer(cols = c(CorrectRecallOld, ForgetRecallOld, CorrectRecallNew, NewRecallOld),
               names_to = "ResponseType", values_to = "Value")

summary_data_long <- summary_data_long %>%
  mutate(AgeGroup = recode(AgeGroup, "OA" = "Old", "YA" = "Young"))

install.packages("RColorBrewer")
library(RColorBrewer)
# Choose a palette and select specific colors
selected_colors <- brewer.pal(5, "Set1")[c(2, 3, 1, 4)]  # Select the 2nd, 1st, 4th, and 5th colors from 'Set1'

# Plot
Freq_Video <- ggplot() +
  # Plot individual data points
  geom_point(data = summary_data_long, aes(x = ToD_Condition, y = Value, color = ResponseType),
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1, dodge.width = 0.9), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  # Plot bars for means
  geom_bar(data = summary_long, aes(x = ToD_Condition, y = Mean, fill = ResponseType),
           stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), color = "black") +
  # Plot error bars
  geom_errorbar(data = summary_long, aes(x = ToD_Condition, ymin = Mean - SE, ymax = Mean + SE, group = ResponseType),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), width = 0.25) +
  # Plot means as text
  geom_text(data = summary_long, aes(x = ToD_Condition, y = Mean, label = round(Mean, 2), group = ResponseType),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), vjust = -0.5) +
  # Facet by AgeGroup
  facet_wrap(~ AgeGroup) +
  # Labels and theme
  labs(title = "Mean Number of Items Identified by Response Type, Age, and Time of Day ",
       x = "Time of Day",
       y = "Mean Number of Responses",
       fill = "Response Type",
       color = "Response Type") +
  # Apply the selected colors to fill and color
  scale_color_manual(values = selected_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = selected_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),  # Centered title
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r Recognition memory }, echo=FALSE}

# Calculate recognition memory performance metrics
RecognitionMemory_Summary <- Summary_Recall_Data %>%
  filter(block=="Overall")%>%
  mutate(
    HitRate = CorrectRecallOld / (CorrectRecallOld + ForgetRecallOld),
    FalseAlarmRate = NewRecallOld / (NewRecallOld + CorrectRecallNew),
   RecognitionScore= HitRate-FalseAlarmRate
  )

RecognitionMemory_Summary %>%
  group_by(AgeGroup) %>%  
  summarise(
    mean_HR = mean(HitRate, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_HR = sd(HitRate, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_FA = mean(FalseAlarmRate, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_FA = sd(FalseAlarmRate, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_Rec = mean( RecognitionScore, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_Rec = sd( RecognitionScore, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )
library(dplyr)

RecognitionMemory_Summary <- RecognitionMemory_Summary%>%
  group_by(AgeGroup) %>%
  mutate(
    z_HitRate = as.numeric(scale(HitRate)),
    z_FalseAlarmRate = as.numeric(scale(FalseAlarmRate)),
    z_RecognitionScore= as.numeric(scale(RecognitionScore)),
    HR_outlier = abs(z_HitRate) > 3,       # strict: >3 SD
    FA_outlier = abs(z_FalseAlarmRate) > 3,
    Rec_outlier=abs(z_RecognitionScore) > 3
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

Summary_All_Overall<-Summary_Data_NoOutliers%>%
  filter(block=="Overall")%>%
  select(participant,absavg_learning:outlier_Recall_Age)

Summary_All_Rec<-merge(Summary_All_Overall, RecognitionMemory_Summary, by="participant")
#Summary data frame for just the block overall!
  
 
write.csv(Summary_All_Rec,
          file = file.path(AbsErr_Data_Dir, "MemoryABS_Rec_Video.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)


write.csv(Summary_All_Rec,
          file = file.path(Clean_Data_Dir, "MemoryABS_Rec_Video.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```
